screen.box.cellsNeeded: A box requires x and y (cells) ({item})
screen.box.group: A group is written with groups of section_update or card_update, which moves what is inside it.
screen.box.itemNeeded: A box requires item (the id of a card or section)
screen.box.kind: A box's kind is card or section (not {kind})
screen.documents.documentsNeeded: document_parts requires documents (the list of document cards)
screen.inserted.pathsNeeded: inserted_values requires paths (the list of paths to put in)
screen.moves.notCard: {target} is not a card (moves goes with a card's rows written whole)
screen.moves.shape: moves is a list of [{"from": [name…], "to": [name…]}] (the names before and after of the rows that moved or were renamed)
screen.moves.withRows: moves goes with rows written whole (it cannot be written together with {stray} in value)
screen.places.boxesNeeded: places requires boxes (the list of boxes to place)
screen.tool.argumentsShape: arguments of tool is an object
screen.what.diagramPath: the path of what to draw as a diagram
screen.what.oldestKept: the number of the oldest commit to keep
screen.what.rulesText: the rule text; empty to go back to the default
